name: OCBC Bank (Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation)

scam_info.sample: Think that call is real? Think again. 12 June 2025 ... In this edition of 'Be A Pro Against Cons with OCBC', we shed light on two kinds of impersonation scams that are on the rise
scam_info.notes: 67 dated advisory editions (2021-11-24 .. 2025-06-12); no new edition since June 2025. Narrative MOs only (no fake domains/numbers); only OCBC's own hotline 6363 3333 / 1800 363 3333 and 'OCBC URL: internet.ocbc.com' (official) appear. Sitemap lastmod 2025-11-05.

scam_info.sample: Keep a record of our channels ... OCBC Internet Banking: https://internet.ocbc.com/internet-banking/ The OCBC app: Apple's App Store Google Play Store Our social media pages: https://www.facebook.com/OCBCBank/
scam_info.notes: (official) Explicit list of genuine OCBC channels: internet-banking URL, app-store links (OCBC Digital id292506828 / com.ocbc.mobile), 4 social URLs, contact tel +6563633333.

scam_info.sample: Do not call any numbers or click on any links in SMSes that claim to be from OCBC. OCBC will never send you SMSes or emails with clickable URLs.
scam_info.notes: Page ScamShield's bank-hotline list links to for OCBC. Gives 1800 363 3333 (+65 6363 3333 overseas), press 8 for fraud/kill switch.

Listed in sitemap (lastmod 2025-11-05) together with ocbc-moneylock.page, shared-responsibility-framework, need-help.page and per-scam-type pages (job/investment/loan/love/malware/ecommerce/impersonation-scams); page itself not fetched (budget).

+65 6363 3333 (OCBC Personal Banking hotline, overseas; also listed as 6363 3333)
